GROUP_MANAGEMENT.TITLE: Groups
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.INTRO: Configure this inbox’s groups, message processing and content access.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.ERROR: The operation could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.ENABLED_HELP: Disabling stops new group ingestion and sends without deleting history.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.DEFAULT_HELP: Defaults apply to new groups. Existing groups are not reclassified.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.EMPTY_ADMIN: No groups found. Refresh the instance catalog.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.FOLLOW_IN_SELECTION: Follow this group when using selected groups only
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.MANAGEMENT_HELP: Management: separate messages and history, without tickets, assignments, SLAs or support automations.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.CONVERSATION_HELP: Support: uses the existing conversation pipeline and ticket rules.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.ACCESS_HELP: Selection also restricts content access for unselected administrators. Inbox administrators can still change this policy.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.IMPACT: Active tickets: {tickets}. Pending or uncertain sends: {pending}.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.TRANSITION_HELP: Changes apply to new messages; history is not converted or deleted. Resolve active tickets and pending sends first. Confirm treatment change?
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.BULK_CONFIRM: Apply the selected options to {count} groups? The entire operation is cancelled if any version conflict, active ticket or pending send exists. History is not converted.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.REPLAY_HELP: Import up to 100 retained events into Management history? No tickets or support alerts will be created.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.EMPTY: No authorized groups in this context.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.REVOKE_CONFIRM: Delete this message for everyone on WhatsApp? This cannot be undone.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.CANCEL_PENDING_CONFIRM: Check WhatsApp first to verify delivery. Cancelling only clears the pending HUB record; it does not delete a delivered message or resend it.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.NO_TICKET: This Support group has no conversation yet. An eligible event will create one according to existing rules.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.READ_ONLY: Preserved read-only history. New messages follow the current treatment.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.FILE_LIMIT: The file must be 25 MB or smaller.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.WAITING_FILE: Media processing. Refresh to check availability.
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.STATUS_UNCERTAIN: Delivery unconfirmed — check WhatsApp before resending
GROUP_MANAGEMENT.HISTORY_NOTE: Earlier messages remain in the history of their original treatment.
